decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through-glass vias are a core, high-value niche for a specialized glass wafer maker like Plan Optik, and MEMS and packaging demand makes them worth developing further rather than abandoning a year after launch.

Carrier wafers for handling smaller diameters are a low-cost extension of the existing glass wafer portfolio, serve recurring customer needs, and use established production capabilities, so there is little reason to drop them.
